text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":12,"unit":"days","kind":"count","span":"hiking every 12 days"},{"id":"q2","value":6,"unit":"days","kind":"count","span":"swimming every 6 days"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"divide hiking cycle (12) by swimming cycle (6) to confirm 12 is an exact multiple of 6"},{"op":"mul","args":["q2","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"multiply swimming cycle (6) by that quotient to reconstruct the least common multiple of the two cycles"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"days from now until both hiking and swimming coincide again"},"dismissed":[]}
